title: Beef and Muffin Kebabs
description: A simple and tasty recipe for beef and muffin kebabs, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 pound beef sirloin, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook to 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare

ingredients.name: 2 Russian muffins, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: You can also use other types of bread

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the beef and muffins

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper to taste
ingredients.notes: For seasoning the beef and muffins

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the beef and muffin pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the beef and muffins with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
Let the beef rest for a few minutes before serving.
Repeat with remaining ingredients if needed.
Clean the grill and utensils thoroughly after use.
